name: Pancho de Bravo!
source:
Kenzaka Rinji is a completely average Private School Student. Due to a random case of mistaken identity, he becomes a member of a group of thieves intent on stealing a golden bra worth one hundred million yen from an art museum.  

Together with Rinji, five beautiful women are after the bra-
The cold-hearted ninja, Hotaru
The explosives expert known as "Bomb Alice", Kudou Alice
The intellectual leader who keeps the group together, Takasaki Rikako
The genius driver with the nickname "Pain Killer", Shirley Baker
The follower of the mysterious "Tenpoke Religion", Maneki Wawawa

Learning the art of stealing underwear while a woman is still wearing it from the master thief Crotch, Rinji and the ladies embark on their "like, totally impossible" mission. 

If Rinji can get his hands on the golden bra, he'll get to have sexy fun with the heroines in their underwear!

translation:
健坂凛二是一名完全普通的私立学校学生。由于一次偶然的身份错误事件，他成为了一群盗贼的成员，意图从美术馆偷走价值一亿日元的金色胸罩。

和凛二一起，五位美女都在追求胸罩——
冷酷的忍者萤
被称为“炸弹爱丽丝”的炸药专家工藤爱丽丝
维持团队凝聚力的知识领袖高崎梨花子
绰号“止痛杀手”的天才车手雪莉·贝克
神秘的“天保教”的信徒，招木娃娃

从大盗Crotch那里学习如何在女人还穿着内衣的时候偷内衣的技巧，林次和女士们开始了他们“几乎不可能”的任务。

如果林次能得到金色胸罩，他就能和穿着内衣的女主角们一起享受性感乐趣！
